-- NEW AXE NET v1.29.0
-- 030_outlaw_module.sql
-- AXE WAR Supabase 프로젝트 > SQL Editor에서 전체 실행
--
-- NEW AXE NET 무법지대 모듈 기반 스키마
-- - 현재 무법지대 통계
-- - 통계 기록 히스토리
-- - 무법지대 공략(지역 + 단계)
-- - 브리핑맵
--
-- 보안 원칙
-- - anon 직접 조회 금지
-- - 일반 멤버는 HttpOnly member session -> Vercel server(service_role) 경로로 조회
-- - Supabase authenticated 직접 조회는 NEW AXE NET 관리자만 허용
-- - Google Sheet / Apps Script 런타임 의존 없음

create schema if not exists new_axe_net;
grant usage on schema new_axe_net to authenticated, service_role;

-- =========================================================
-- 1) 현재 무법지대 통계
-- =========================================================

create table if not exists new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current (
  id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,
  member_key text not null unique
    references new_axe_net.members(member_key)
    on update cascade on delete cascade,
  source_nickname text not null,
  discord_user_id text not null unique,
  total_kills integer not null default 0 check (total_kills >= 0),
  total_deaths integer not null default 0 check (total_deaths >= 0),
  kd numeric(10,2) generated always as (
    case
      when total_deaths = 0 then total_kills::numeric
      else round(total_kills::numeric / total_deaths::numeric, 2)
    end
  ) stored,
  last_message_id text,
  source_image_url text,
  source_updated_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outlaw_stats_current_rank_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current
  (total_kills desc, kd desc, total_deaths asc);

create index if not exists outlaw_stats_current_updated_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current (source_updated_at desc);

drop trigger if exists outlaw_stats_current_touch_updated_at
on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current;

create trigger outlaw_stats_current_touch_updated_at
before update on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current
for each row
execute function new_axe_net.touch_updated_at();


-- =========================================================
-- 2) 무법지대 통계 기록
-- =========================================================

create table if not exists new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history (
  record_id text primary key,
  member_key text not null
    references new_axe_net.members(member_key)
    on update cascade on delete cascade,
  source_nickname text not null,
  total_kills integer not null check (total_kills >= 0),
  total_deaths integer not null check (total_deaths >= 0),
  kill_delta integer not null default 0 check (kill_delta >= 0),
  death_delta integer not null default 0 check (death_delta >= 0),
  delta_kd numeric(10,2) not null default 0,
  channel_id text,
  discord_user_id text,
  message_id text,
  source_image_url text,
  confidence numeric(5,2),
  status text not null default 'approved'
    check (status in ('approved','pending','rejected')),
  recorded_at timestamptz not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outlaw_stats_history_member_recorded_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history (member_key, recorded_at desc);

create index if not exists outlaw_stats_history_recorded_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history (recorded_at desc);

create unique index if not exists outlaw_stats_history_message_unique
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history (message_id)
  where message_id is not null;


-- =========================================================
-- 3) 무법지대 공략 지역
-- =========================================================

create table if not exists new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations (
  location_key text primary key,
  map_name text not null,
  main_image text,
  coord text,
  active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outlaw_guide_locations_active_order_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations (active, sort_order, location_key);

drop trigger if exists outlaw_guide_locations_touch_updated_at
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations;

create trigger outlaw_guide_locations_touch_updated_at
before update on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations
for each row
execute function new_axe_net.touch_updated_at();


-- =========================================================
-- 4) 무법지대 공략 단계
-- =========================================================

create table if not exists new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps (
  id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,
  location_key text not null
    references new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations(location_key)
    on update cascade on delete cascade,
  route_group text not null default '기본 루트',
  step_no text not null,
  title text not null,
  content text,
  image text,
  video_url text,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (location_key, route_group, step_no)
);

create index if not exists outlaw_guide_steps_location_order_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps
  (location_key, active, sort_order, id);

drop trigger if exists outlaw_guide_steps_touch_updated_at
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps;

create trigger outlaw_guide_steps_touch_updated_at
before update on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps
for each row
execute function new_axe_net.touch_updated_at();


-- =========================================================
-- 5) 브리핑맵
-- =========================================================

create table if not exists new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps (
  map_key text primary key,
  map_name text not null,
  image text,
  description text,
  note text,
  coord text,
  source_updated_at date,
  active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outlaw_briefing_maps_active_order_idx
  on new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps (active, sort_order, map_key);

drop trigger if exists outlaw_briefing_maps_touch_updated_at
on new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps;

create trigger outlaw_briefing_maps_touch_updated_at
before update on new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps
for each row
execute function new_axe_net.touch_updated_at();


-- =========================================================
-- 6) RLS / 권한
-- =========================================================

alter table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current enable row level security;
alter table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history enable row level security;
alter table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations enable row level security;
alter table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps enable row level security;
alter table new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps enable row level security;

revoke all on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current
from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history
from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations
from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps
from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on table new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps
from public, anon, authenticated;

grant select on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current to authenticated;
grant select on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history to authenticated;
grant select on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations to authenticated;
grant select on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps to authenticated;
grant select on table new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps to authenticated;

grant select, insert, update, delete
on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete
on table new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete
on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete
on table new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete
on table new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps to service_role;

grant usage, select on all sequences
in schema new_axe_net to service_role;

drop policy if exists outlaw_stats_current_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current;
create policy outlaw_stats_current_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current
for select to authenticated
using (new_axe_net.is_admin());

drop policy if exists outlaw_stats_history_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history;
create policy outlaw_stats_history_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history
for select to authenticated
using (new_axe_net.is_admin());

drop policy if exists outlaw_guide_locations_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations;
create policy outlaw_guide_locations_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations
for select to authenticated
using (new_axe_net.is_admin());

drop policy if exists outlaw_guide_steps_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps;
create policy outlaw_guide_steps_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps
for select to authenticated
using (new_axe_net.is_admin());

drop policy if exists outlaw_briefing_maps_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps;
create policy outlaw_briefing_maps_admin_read
on new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps
for select to authenticated
using (new_axe_net.is_admin());

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';


-- =========================================================
-- NEXT: 031
-- =========================================================

-- NEW AXE NET v1.29.0
-- 031_outlaw_legacy_import.sql
-- 사용자 제공 CSV 4종을 new_axe_net 무법지대 모듈로 1회 이관합니다.
-- SOURCE: 현재통계 19 / 기록 472 / 브리핑맵 17 / 공략 3지역 10단계
-- 전제: 030_outlaw_module.sql 실행 완료
-- OCR 원문·만료형 Discord 이미지 URL·채널ID는 새 웹에 불필요해 legacy import에서 제외합니다.
-- 통계값·증가량·message_id·기록시각은 보존합니다.
-- history record_id는 안정적인 legacy_<message_id> 형식으로 생성합니다.

-- 1) 현재 통계 19건
WITH source (source_nickname,total_kills,total_deaths,last_message_id,discord_user_id,source_updated_at) AS (
  VALUES

    ('벚꽃',254,487,'1540613337329438762','731516789917483049',('2026-08-22 15:47:26'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('박두억',1659,676,'1541082490981064794','355887922597199876',('2026-08-23 22:51:42'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('햇밥',197,156,'1541082534245306448','369020109399916544',('2026-08-23 22:51:52'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('키스',458,569,'1538180805636128838','578196304803528724',('2026-08-15 22:41:25'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('물소',194,188,'1538555345209790565','307908333447282689',('2026-08-16 23:29:42'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('김공찬',26,60,'1540718208359604224','291170479916580865',('2026-08-22 22:44:10'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')),
    ('연우',46,80,'1541082618559336550','1538094021270966336',('2026-08-23 22:52:12'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'))
), resolved AS (
  SELECT m.member_key,s.* FROM source s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.member_key FROM new_axe_net.members m
    WHERE m.discord_user_id=s.discord_user_id
       OR lower(btrim(m.nickname))=lower(btrim(s.source_nickname))
       OR (s.source_nickname='ෆ야미ෆ' AND m.nickname='얌이')
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.discord_user_id=s.discord_user_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,m.id
    LIMIT 1
  ) m ON true
)
INSERT INTO new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current
  (member_key,source_nickname,discord_user_id,total_kills,total_deaths,last_message_id,source_image_url,source_updated_at)
SELECT member_key,source_nickname,discord_user_id,total_kills,total_deaths,last_message_id,NULL,source_updated_at FROM resolved
ON CONFLICT (member_key) DO UPDATE SET
  source_nickname=excluded.source_nickname,discord_user_id=excluded.discord_user_id,
  total_kills=excluded.total_kills,total_deaths=excluded.total_deaths,
  last_message_id=excluded.last_message_id,source_image_url=NULL,
  source_updated_at=excluded.source_updated_at,updated_at=now();

만석침|1785|932|8|6|1.33|1541083008617021502|2026-08-23 22:53:45
샹크스|521|860|3|3|1.00|1541083020919054367|2026-08-23 22:53:47

구만집|896|406|9|4|2.25|1541091209588641823|2026-08-23 23:26:20
$outlaw_history$)),
source AS (
  SELECT
    a[1] AS source_nickname,
    a[2]::integer AS total_kills,
    a[3]::integer AS total_deaths,
    a[4]::integer AS kill_delta,
    a[5]::integer AS death_delta,
    a[6]::numeric(10,2) AS delta_kd,
    a[7] AS message_id,
    (a[8]::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS recorded_at
  FROM raw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(data,E'\n') AS line
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_to_array(line,'|') AS a) x
  WHERE btrim(line)<>''
), resolved AS (
  SELECT 'legacy_'||s.message_id AS record_id,m.member_key,s.*
  FROM source s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.member_key FROM new_axe_net.members m
    WHERE lower(btrim(m.nickname))=lower(btrim(s.source_nickname))
       OR (s.source_nickname='양파' AND m.nickname='칭찬양파')
       OR (s.source_nickname='형석' AND m.nickname='김형석')
       OR (s.source_nickname='김안녕*' AND m.nickname='김안녕')
       OR (s.source_nickname='ෆ야미ෆ' AND m.nickname='얌이')
    ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
  ) m ON true
)
INSERT INTO new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history
  (record_id,member_key,source_nickname,total_kills,total_deaths,kill_delta,death_delta,delta_kd,
   channel_id,discord_user_id,message_id,source_image_url,confidence,status,recorded_at)
SELECT record_id,member_key,source_nickname,total_kills,total_deaths,kill_delta,death_delta,delta_kd,
       NULL,NULL,message_id,NULL,NULL,'approved',recorded_at FROM resolved
ON CONFLICT (record_id) DO UPDATE SET
  member_key=excluded.member_key,source_nickname=excluded.source_nickname,
  total_kills=excluded.total_kills,total_deaths=excluded.total_deaths,
  kill_delta=excluded.kill_delta,death_delta=excluded.death_delta,delta_kd=excluded.delta_kd,
  message_id=excluded.message_id,status='approved',recorded_at=excluded.recorded_at;

-- 6) 검증
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current) AS current_stats,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_history WHERE record_id LIKE 'legacy_%') AS history_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_briefing_maps) AS briefing_maps,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_locations) AS guide_locations,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_guide_steps) AS guide_steps;

SELECT count(*) AS linked_current,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS unlinked_current
FROM new_axe_net.outlaw_stats_current s
LEFT JOIN new_axe_net.members m ON m.member_key=s.member_key;

-- 기대값: current_stats=19 / history_rows=472 / briefing_maps=17 / guide_locations=3 / guide_steps=10
--         linked_current=19 / unlinked_current=0
notify pgrst, 'reload schema';
